legal.title: Legal information
legal.intro: Information about the portfolio’s publisher, hosting and the data used for its operation.

edition.title: Website publisher
edition.text: This portfolio is published on a personal, non-professional basis by Adrien POURLIER, who is also the publication director.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.first: The website, its API and the featured projects are hosted in France on personal infrastructure managed by the publisher. Docker runs the services and Cloudflare Tunnel makes them securely available on the Internet.
hosting.second: The publisher is directly responsible for the availability, maintenance and backup of this infrastructure.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.first: The portfolio does not provide visitor accounts, a contact form, advertising or audience measurement tools. No data is sold or used to build advertising profiles.
privacy.second: As with any web service, technical information such as the IP address, connection date, requested resource or browser type may be processed temporarily by the server and network intermediaries to route requests, maintain the service and keep it secure.
privacy.note: Messages sent to the contact address are processed solely to reply to their sender.

storage.title: Cookies and local storage
storage.first: The achievement system uses the browser’s <storage>localStorage</storage>. This information remains on the device and is not sent to the server.
storage.retention: These entries are retained until they are removed through the browser settings. Removing them resets all or part of the achievement progress.
storage.session: A strictly functional session cookie may also be used to authenticate the administration area. It is not intended to track visitors and expires with the browser session.

entries.visited: Counts the visits required for certain achievements.
entries.explorer: Stores the pages that have already been explored.
entries.projects: Stores viewed projects without recording their content.
entries.days: Stores visit days for return achievements.

services.title: External services
services.intro: Depending on the page viewed, the browser may contact:
services.cloudflare: for secure access to the website;
services.iframes: services required by interactive projects embedded in iframes.
services.links: Links to GitHub, LinkedIn or Ko-fi open separate websites with their own privacy policies.

property.title: Intellectual property
property.first: Unless otherwise stated, the text, interfaces, graphic elements and projects presented on this portfolio are the property of their author. Any substantial reproduction or reuse requires prior permission.
property.second: Third-party trademarks, libraries, resources and services remain the property of their respective owners.

liability.title: Liability
liability.text: The information and demonstrations are provided for informational purposes. Despite the care taken with the portfolio, the publisher cannot guarantee permanent availability or the complete absence of errors. The publisher is not responsible for external links or their content.
